hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that runs a buyback-and-burn mechanism on every swap in configured pools: after each swap, it spends secondary token donations to buy back the pool's designated main token and delivers it to a configured recipient (burn by default via address(0)). It also supports auto-compounding LP fee programs with configurable splits among compounding, buyback, burn, and direct delivery shares.
